'''Metrobig Interplanetary Blastport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Metrobig City]] on [[Skor II]]. It was taken over by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and later liberated by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Battle of Skor II]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
